mapper.sql: a.achievement_id, a.management_no, a.teacher_user_id, u.login_id AS teacher_name, a.organization_code, a.evaluation_year, a.management_item_code, a.achievement_date, a.achievement_status, d.special_lecture_start_date, d.special_lecture_end_date, d.mock_exam_question_period, a.attachment_ids, a.created_at, a.updated_at
FROM education_achievements a JOIN employment_rate_improvement_achievement_details d ON d.achievement_id = a.achievement_id JOIN users u ON u.user_id = a.teacher_user_id
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE a.achievement_id = #{id} AND a.achievement_type = 'employment-rate-improvements' AND a.deleted_yn = 'N' FOR UPDATE OF a, d

SELECT DISTINCT m.organization_code FROM organization_user_mappings m WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.mapping_type = 'ORGANIZATION' AND m.effective_start_date <= CURRENT_DATE AND (m.effective_end_date IS NULL OR m.effective_end_date >= CURRENT_DATE) ORDER BY m.organization_code
SELECT u.user_id FROM users u WHERE u.user_id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT m.management_item_code, MIN(m.management_item_name) AS management_item_name FROM evaluation_management_items m JOIN evaluation_elements e ON e.element_id = m.element_id JOIN evaluation_items i ON i.item_id = e.item_id JOIN evaluation_areas a ON a.area_id = i.area_id JOIN evaluation_element_management_item_settings s ON s.rule_version_id = a.rule_version_id AND s.area_code = a.area_code AND s.item_code = i.item_code AND s.element_code = e.element_code AND s.evaluation_year = e.evaluation_year AND s.management_item_code = m.management_item_code WHERE a.area_code = 'EDUCATION' AND e.evaluation_year = #{year} AND s.target_scope = #{organization} AND a.active_yn = 'Y' AND i.active_yn = 'Y' AND e.active_yn = 'Y' AND m.active_yn = 'Y' AND s.active_yn = 'Y' AND m.teacher_editable_yn = 'Y' AND s.teacher_editable_yn = 'Y' AND s.effective_start_date <= to_date(#{year} || '-12-31', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND s.effective_end_date >= to_date(#{year} || '-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') GROUP BY m.management_item_code HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m.management_item_id) = 1 ORDER BY m.management_item_code
mapper.update: UPDATE education_achievements SET management_item_code = #{managementItemCode}, achievement_date = #{achievementDate}, attachment_ids = CAST(#{attachmentJson} AS jsonb), updated_by = #{userId}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, request_id = #{requestId} WHERE achievement_id = #{achievementId} AND achievement_type = 'employment-rate-improvements' AND achievement_status IN ('DRAFT', 'DEPARTMENT_REJECTED', 'CERTIFICATION_REJECTED') AND deleted_yn = 'N'
